unsupported: The company was founded in 2018 by Matt Ruben, who began with a single portable sawmill and a vision to reclaim fallen Minnesota trees and transform them into lasting works of art.
Customers are primarily residential homeowners and DIY enthusiasts in the Twin Cities area who seek one-of-a-kind furniture or need logs milled from their own land.

Testimonials reference projects such as a custom black walnut mantel fitted over an existing stone surround, a dining table built from a client's own cherry and burr oak logs, and a coffee table crafted from supplied slabs.
The business also works with contractors and designers on custom countertop installations.
